comment: ModelSample: a new sword with its own model. The two GUIDs are resources this mod serves through kiln.assets (assets/assets.json): 08525f9a... = the keen::RenderModel (the tower sword), 699ccb5f... = its visual template (a copy of the Bronze Sword's with the model swapped). The hand recipe costs one twig so the sword is easy to try.

add.name: Kiln_Sample_TowerSword
add.description: Three cubes and a slab. Its model was cooked from glTF by Kiln's modelcook.
